text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lively voices can be heard coming from the 
stands by the training track—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I see, I see! This is quite 
educational~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she can even run like that?! 
T-That's incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's focusing on her pivot 
foot? Whoa... Look at that clean 
acceleration...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Are you here to observe the training 
too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so amazing~ They really show 
what Tracen Academy Umamusume are made of!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The girl running over there... her 
late-race sprint is like a rushing 
gale—absolutely incredible.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The timing of that burst was pure genius! 
I'd love to ask for some pointers~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And over there, that girl just has the 
most incredible stamina!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, lunch was always 
a giant portion. I see, maybe that's why.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And over there, Ikuno Dictus is doing some 
self-training right now—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Stuff like this is totally normal~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really don't have anything I can brag 
about, so I feel like I should at least do 
this much~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So whenever I spot an amazing girl, I just 
kind of dash around all over the place, 
like swoooosh...
choice_data_list:
That agility is definitely beyond 
ordinary.
That power is anything but ordinary.
That power is anything but ordinary, huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So whenever I spot an amazing girl, I just 
kind of dash around all over the place, 
like swoooosh...
choice_data_list:
That agility is definitely beyond 
ordinary.
That power is anything but ordinary.
That power is anything but ordinary, huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Look at you talking like that~! Praising 
me isn't gonna get you anything, you 
know~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I know better than anyone that 
I'm just 'ordinary'—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Ikuno, is your legwork 
looking a bit different from usual...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying out a new form by any 
chance? Waaah, now I'm super curious~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'll take my leave now! Hey, 
Ikunooo! Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser bolted off with an 
agility that was anything but 'ordinary.'

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Oh, stop flattering me so much~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm really just an ordinary Umamusume... 
Oh. Did Ikuno finish her training?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm going to go over to where 
Ikuno is.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's a lot of equipment left 
from training, so I'll zip over and help 
clean up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to help much, but 
cleaning up together should still be 
faster than doing it alone~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Matikanetannhauser packed away 
the equipment in the blink of an eye, 
demonstrating strength that seemed 
anything but "ordinary."
